name: Epaphroditus
description: Man living at the time of the New Testament

points: “Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier”. “and he that ministered to my wants.” Epaphroditus helped Paul out and ministered to his wants.

note.label: When Good Intentions Lead To Bad Judgement In Israel

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Epaphroditus
cases.charge: For the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me
cases.preview: Paul, writing from confinement in Rome, called Epaphroditus his brother, companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, and the congregation’s messenger who ministered to his wants (Philippians 2:25).
